packageRules.description: Automerge minor and patch updates across all managers. Group rules below set groupName only — no automerge, so this rule remains the single source of truth for automerge.
Group all Go module updates into one PR
Group .tektonic/ npm updates; keeps CI pipeline deps separate from the web app
Group web/ npm updates separately from .tektonic/
Track @pfenerty/tektonic minor/patch via git tags — automerge after re-synth
@pfenerty/tektonic major — hold for manual review and re-synth

customManagers.description: Bump base/tool image tags in the tektonic TypeScript source (.tektonic/**/*.ts) in lockstep with the generated .tekton/ YAML, so re-synthesis never reverts a Renovate bump.
